customize.name: Lakkaberry Pie
customize.desc: A sweet treat from the borderlands. Once made using nothing but Lakkaberries, the recipe was later enhanced by adding Midsommar Berries to the mix. The two fruits complement each other perfectly, giving this sweet pie a rich, enticing flavor. The original name, however, remains unchanged.

customize.name: Delicious Lakkaberry Pie
customize.desc: A sweet treat from the borderlands. The comforting aroma of freshly baked pastry blends perfectly with the sweet yet tart flavor of the succulent two-berry filling. Rich flavors dance vividly across your tongue — no wonder this delightfully punchy treat has become a beloved and comforting staple on the tables of Nod-Krai.

customize.name: Suspicious Lakkaberry Pie
customize.desc: A sweet treat from the borderlands. After mustering your full strength to bite through the near-impregnable crust, the coarse chunks of pastry grate against the inside of your mouth like rocks. Fortunately, just as you're questioning your life choices — or at least those that apply to baked goods — a slight hint of berries hits your palate, reminding you that you are, in fact, not eating frozen soil...

customize.name: Iridescence Under the Tree's Shade
customize.desc: Linnea's specialty. A "Lumi" crafted from sour cream sits at the center, surrounded by fruits that look like crystallized rainbows. Its adorable appearance brings warmth to one's heart. Upon closer inspection, each fruit bears the signature of a different land... The care she took in traversing mountains and rivers to gather these speaks louder than a thousand words.

customize.name: Lakkaberry
customize.desc:
A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.
In the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.
Even when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

customize.name: Midsommar Berry
customize.desc:
A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.
In the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.
There is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Holly and the King of Summer Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

customize.name: Rye Flour
customize.desc: A coarse, dark powder produced from grinding rye. Food made with it has a unique texture and a somewhat sour flavor.

customize.name: Smetana
customize.desc: A dairy product produced through complex processes such as separation and fermentation. It has a smooth texture and a refreshing sourness, often serving as the finishing touch in many dishes.
